name: Betafied
description:
BETAFIED: MINECRAFT BETA 1.7.3 FOR BEDROCK

Betafied brings Minecraft Java Beta 1.7.3 gameplay to Bedrock Edition.

Connect from any Bedrock platform (Windows, iOS, Android, or consoles). You do not need to install any files before joining. The server sends the custom texture and behavior packs to your client automatically when you connect.

The server pairs original 2011 survival mechanics with grief prevention and multiplayer commands.

BETA 1.7.3 MECHANICS 

• Classic Health: No hunger bar. Eating food restores hearts immediately. 

• Original Movement: No sprinting. Pacing relies on regular walking and minecart tracks. 

• Beta World Generation: Classic biome layouts, gravel beaches, alpha grass palettes, and retro lighting. 

• Combat: Fast weapon hits, punch bows, and high mob damage at night. 

• Audio & Visuals: Original Beta sound effects, classic void fog, and legacy blocks.

SURVIVAL MULTIPLAYER SYSTEMS 

• Land Claims: Claim territory using a chest and fuel to protect your builds. 

• Locks: Lock chests, furnaces, and doors to prevent theft. 

• Player Shops: Create chest and sign shops to trade items with other players. 

• Homes & Teleporting: Save your base with /sethome and send teleport requests with /tpa. 

• Clans: Form groups, share base access, and talk in private clan chat. 

• Uptime: Persistent survival world hosted 24/7.

HOW TO JOIN

Open Minecraft Bedrock.

Go to Play > Servers > Add Server.

Enter Betafied for the name and play.betafied.net for the address.

Leave the port as 19132.

Select Save, then Join. Accept the pack download on your first join to load in.

OR

add "Betafied Server" as a friend on Xbox and join!
